root_idea.summary: The root denotes intensity, force, and hardship, with كَبِدٌ naming the liver and كَبَدٌ naming difficulty or distress.
root_idea.development: The lexical network extends from the liver and its pain to endurance under difficulty, while the liver's central bodily position motivates meanings of middle, main part, and central location.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested noun is presented under the normalized citation form كَبَد.

senses.definition: Hardship, distress, or affliction; the difficult condition in which human life is lived.
senses.usage_conditions: In the construction فِي كَبَدٍ, as in 90:4; the sense includes the state of enduring the difficulties of worldly life.

senses.definition: A right, upright, and properly proportioned state of human constitution.
senses.usage_conditions: An alternative interpretation of فِي كَبَدٍ; the reported explanations include upright bipedal posture and just proportion.

senses.definition: The position of the human fetus in the womb before birth, with its head toward the mother's head and later turning for delivery.
senses.usage_conditions: Another reported interpretation of the construction فِي كَبَدٍ; the packet supplies no separate Quran location for this interpretation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hit, strike, or hurt someone's liver.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form I verbal use; the object is the liver.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To affect severely, distress, or straiten someone; literally, to smite the liver.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical Form I use, attested especially of intense cold and its effects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To suffer pain or a disease of the liver.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I intransitive use; the related passive expression denotes being afflicted in the liver.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be large or thick in the middle or upper part of the belly, and consequently slow in movement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I bodily-description use, applied to a person or to anything large and thick in its middle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To endure, undergo, or struggle against a thing's difficulty, trouble, or severity; to contend against opposition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III; it is used of braving a difficult night or other severe circumstance and of mutual contention between adversaries.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To direct oneself or one's course toward an affair, town, country, or the middle or main part of a desert.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V tropical use of directing oneself toward a destination or central region.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become thick or coagulated, like liver.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of milk and other beverages.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For the sun or a star to reach the middle of the sky and culminate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V astronomical use, including the sun's position in the central sky.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The liver, the fleshy organ on the right side of the lungs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The standard anatomical noun; it has recognized variant vocalizations and feminine, and occasionally masculine, grammatical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The external side or the place corresponding to the liver.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical anatomical extension, referring to the outside of the body near the liver.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The inside or interior of an animal as a whole.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributed tropical extension of the anatomical meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The interior of a mountain, including a cave or ravine within it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical spatial use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The interior or hidden belly of the earth, especially its minerals, gold, silver, and other treasures.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional tropical expression for subterranean contents.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The middle or main part of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The extension is used of the middle of the sea, an archery butt, a tract of sand, and a central locality.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The middle or meridian of the sky, including the central part facing the observer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized spatial expression; كُبَيْدَاءُ السَّمَاءِ and كُبَيْدَاتٌ are also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The air or atmosphere.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported tropical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The handle or central section of a bow, including the part along which the arrow runs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The precise extent varies in the lexical descriptions, but it denotes the bow's central grip or adjoining central section.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person to whom people journey in pursuit of knowledge or another valued attainment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression literally referring to the livers of camels being directed or driven toward someone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A designation for enemies, figuratively black-livered because of rancor or malevolence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic plural expression based on the liver as the supposed source of enmity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Pain, disease, or complaint of the liver.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A deverbal noun naming the illness of the affected organ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A species of lemon or related citrus plant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective botanical noun with a singular form in ـة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A struggle or sustained endurance against difficulty; a state of mutual contention.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantivized form associated with كَابَدَ, also used of adversaries struggling against one another in a contest or dispute.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Large or thick in the middle or upper belly; having a prominent or raised liver region.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related feminine كَبْدَاءُ is also applied to a she-camel or to a tract of sand described as large in the middle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bow whose handle fills the hand or whose central part is thick and strong.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine descriptive form derived from the central or thick part called the كَبِد.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hand-turned mill.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tropical naming based on the difficulty or trouble involved in turning it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain bird.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexicalized nominal use distinct from the adjective meaning large or thick in the middle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hit or hurt in the liver, or suffering a complaint or pain of the liver.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial form describing the person affected in the liver.
